quote: Caribbean Cement Company Limited (CCCL), a subsidiary of global building materials leader, Cemex, commissioned its US$42 million Debottleneck Project at its Rockfort facility in East Kingston earlier today. … The scope of work for the project included the installation of a new main baghouse, a solid fuel dosing system with storage silo, CO₂ fire suppression and inerting systems, upgraded process ducts, a new compressed air system, and a kiln chimney.
note: Opened Carib Cement Rockfort USD 42m commissioning release.
